children: may retest a resistance at $5,665 per metric ton, with a good chance of breaking above it and rising to $5,793.

A small inverted head-and-shoulders has been confirmed, suggesting a target of $5,793. The correction triggered by the resistance at $5,665 is considered a pullback towards the neckline of the pattern.
A break below $5,538 may be followed by a drop to $5,380.
* The cocoa report is published every Wednesday and Friday.
